description: The delegate's countersignature on a recorded delegation: send the delegate token from delegation.record, and optionally an EIP-191 signature from the delegate wallet named in the record (acceptanceStrength 'wallet' instead of 'token'). Returns a signed AgentDelegationAcceptance that hashes the record. Free when the delegation was bought as bundle.delegation-chain. (x402: $0.02 USDC per call)
name: delegation.accept
